rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for someone who performs massage, including a male masseur.

example.english: The masseur at this therapy centre is very professional, so I’ll look for him again next time.
example.traditional: 呢間理療中心嘅按摩師手勢好專業，我下次仲會搵佢。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 lei5 liu4 zung1 sam1 ge3 on3 mo1 si1 sau2 sai3 hou2 zyun1 jip6 ngo5 haa6 ci3 zung6 wui6 wan2 keoi5

rows.note: Use this colloquial respectful term when referring to the massage worker as a skilled practitioner.

example.english: The masseur downstairs is very skilled, and I feel completely relaxed after the massage.
example.traditional: 我樓下嗰位按摩師傅手勢好好，按完個人鬆晒。
example.jyutping: ngo5 lau4 haa6 go2 wai6 on3 mo1 si1 fu2 sau2 sai3 hou2 hou2 on3 jyun4 go3 jan4 sung1 saai3

rows.note: Use this when you need to make the fact that the masseur is male explicit.

example.english: This beauty salon hired a male masseur who specializes in post-exercise relief for male customers.
example.traditional: 呢間美容院請咗個男按摩師，專幫男客做運動後舒緩。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 mei5 jung4 jyun2 ceng2 zo2 go3 naam4 on3 mo1 si1 zyun1 bong1 naam4 haak3 zou6 wan6 dung6 hau6 syu1 wun6
